name: A Bundle of Trouble
summary: At Eastvale Logging Camp, Supervisor Raelen races to meet a timber shipment deadline for Stormwind. Wolves and bears have driven her woodcutters from the northern woods, leaving the cut bundles behind.

sections.title: A Looming Deadline
sections.body: Eastvale's timber rebuilds towns and strengthens bridges across the kingdom, yet this vital shipment has fallen behind. The delivery deadline is drawing near, and Supervisor Raelen has little time to spare.

sections.title: Predators in the Timber
sections.body: North of the camp, wolves and bears drove the woodcutters from the bundles they cut and tied. Raelen cannot wait for guards to clear the woods, so she asks you to bring the timber back before the contract is lost.

faq.answer: Supervisor Raelen manages Eastvale Logging Camp in eastern Elwynn Forest. She oversees the woodcutters and timber shipments bound for Stormwind and nearby settlements.

faq.q: Why is the wood abandoned in the woods?
faq.answer: The laborers had cut and bundled the logs before bears and wolves drove them from the clearing. They fled to camp without the wood.

faq.q: Why does Raelen mention Deputy Rainer?
faq.answer: Raelen says she contacted Deputy Rainer about the predators. He is stationed at Westbrook Garrison, far across Elwynn Forest. The message may have passed through the guards, or local authority may be stretched thin.
Eastvale Logging Camp sends timber throughout the kingdom to rebuild towns and strengthen palisades and bridges. A missed deadline can hurt Elwynn's economy and delay construction.

faq.q: Why can't the loggers collect the wood themselves?
faq.answer: The woodcutters are laborers who fell trees, not fighters trained to face predators. Wolves and bears drove them away, and they will not return to the thicket unarmed.

faq.q: Where can the bundles of wood be found?
faq.answer: The bundles lie in the woods just north of Eastvale Logging Camp, where the laborers were working before local beasts drove them away.

angles.text: As an Alliance member, you can help keep Stormwind's rebuilding and regional outposts supplied with lumber from Eastvale.
As a hunter, you can track through predator-filled groves and face the local beasts while recovering the supplies.
